description: Two files set kernel.kptr_restrict to different values, one in /run/sysctl.d and one in /etc/sysctl.d. procps and systemd-sysctl walk the directories in different orders, so which value is in force after a reboot depends on which tool applied them — UNKNOWN naming both files rather than a confident claim. dmesg_restrict is set once and consistently, so KERNEL-0019 still reaches a verdict: a conflict about one parameter must not silence the other check.
